resource_snapshot_sha256.description: Semantic hash of the resource snapshot the plan is bound to.

checks.description: Check ids must be unique; the runtime rejects duplicates with DUPLICATE_CHECK_ID.

direction.description: either takes the required sign from the observed slope and still requires the split-half shift to agree.

min_cells.description: Observed non-null cells required inside the window; fewer abstains as TREND_MIN_CELLS_NOT_MET. Each half of the window must also contain at least floor(min_cells / 2) observed cells; otherwise the check abstains as TREND_HALF_CELLS_NOT_MET.

min_slope_units_per_second.description: Minimum absolute OLS slope in series units per second. Runtime additionally enforces token, precision, fractional-digit and exponent limits.

min_split_half_shift_pct.description: Minimum absolute split-half median shift as a percentage of the window median. The median must be non-zero, otherwise the check abstains as TREND_MEDIAN_ZERO.
